title: TOPIK I (beginner) vocabulary — NIKL grade A + standard-curriculum 초급

sourceNotes.NIKL-A: 국립국어원 「한국어 학습용 어휘 목록」 (2003), grade A (1단계). Homonym numbers as in that list.
sourceNotes.NIKL-STD-초급: 국립국어원 「한국어 교육 어휘 내용 개발」 초급 list, the vocabulary companion of the 국제 통용 한국어 표준 교육과정: stage 1 (2012) 초급 어휘 선정 목록, membership checked against the final stage 4 (2015) list. Homonym numbers as in the stage 1 list. Entries in both lists are tagged NIKL-A.
sourceNotes.order: Grade A words by the list's frequency rank (unranked proper nouns last), then the remaining 초급 words by corpus frequency (강범모 외 2009 column of the 2012 list).
